A.notes: Picks Creed on Nellie's insult 'a thousand years old' and banter (S8E21 sc.37) plus memory, and misstates Phyllis (sc.37-38 is her late orgasm, not Bob). Meredith named as rival with the supplier deal from memory; its counterpoint undercuts the verdict.

B.notes: Quotes are real but the Creed verdict rests on an insult ('a thousand years old') and the Union of the Monkey gag read as evidence; Meredith's Hammermill evidence (S5E2) was not sent.

C.notes: Picks Creed from his own '60s boast (S3E1 sc.40, a punchline) while correctly citing Meredith's supplier arrangement (S5E2), which is the better-supported case; hedged and flagged as unreliable.
